tools.name: catalog_streams
tools.description:
List of data streams: name, tier, kind, day range, description.
    all=True also lists streams outside your plan, marked `available_on`.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Columns and types of a stream.

tools.name: get_quality
tools.description: Q index and data-quality metrics of a day (day as YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: sql_query
tools.description:
SELECT/WITH over the streams (the day is a virtual column `day`).
    The result holds at most min(limit, 50000) rows.

tools.name: save_strategy
tools.description:
Save a strategy (the contract is in get_contract_docs).
    Returns strategy_id, version and the lint result.

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: My strategies: id, name, version, latest FARM.

tools.name: run_backtest
tools.description:
Queue a backtest. Needs strategy_id OR code (a one-off strategy).
    Minutes are charged at queue time.

tools.name: backtest_status
tools.description: Run status: queued | running (+progress) | done | failed.

tools.name: backtest_report
tools.description: Full report of a finished run: FARM, PnL, WR, DD, regimes, trades.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Latest runs: id, status, FARM, parameters, queue time.

tools.name: get_contract_docs
tools.description: Strategy contract and sandbox rules (the same text as on /docs-contract).

tools.name: get_ai_levels
tools.description: Recorded AI levels, prediction history and observed outcomes. Free access is delayed.

tools.name: get_ai_trader
tools.description: Our AI trader: training status, latest exam on held-out weeks after fees, released decisions (free: 24 h delay).
